cohorts.scope: Declared repository- and owner-disjoint cohorts, packed by whole owner so a requested share is approached rather than hit. Forks, backports, vendored copies and pretraining exposure are not detected here, so this is not an unseen-data guarantee.

exposure.limitation: A lower bound on exposure. Forks, backports, vendored copies and pretraining exposure are not covered.

scope: Metadata eligibility, reproducible selection and declared disjoint cohorts. No rights clearance, no replay verification, no training approval, and not an unseen-data guarantee.

screening.scope: Metadata eligibility only. A licence label is evidence for a rights review, not a clearance. Exclusions reduce known contamination and do not establish that the remainder is unseen. No issue text, source or reference patch was read.

selection.scope: Deterministic, reproducible breadth-first selection under declared caps. Hash ordering is a selection rule, not statistical independence, and a met target is not evidence of sufficiency.
